geometry.coordinates: source v3a right-handed SI coordinates; +x is VLM freestream direction, +z upward; no body aerodynamic model
geometry.structural_model: one constant-EI clamped-free equivalent spanwise scaffold per fin; chord/axial directions constrained, no finite torsional compliance; NOT anatomy-resolved fin rays or ecology hinge stiffness
geometry.beam_kernel: superpose existing Hermite FEM tip-load responses at each actual span load station; unloaded portion extends linearly; no duplicate beam solver
geometry.deflection_map: Xdeformed=Xsource+w(s)*n_up; normals transformed by inverse-transpose of I+w_prime*n_up tensor e_u, then normalized; source camber normals retained as VLM approximation
geometry.load_map: VLM bound-segment forces applied at segment midpoint; projectnormalforces, group common span stations; preserve normal resultant,firstmoment andvirtualwork. Full tangentialforce/torsional/moment constraint reactions retained separately, not silently discarded.

parameters.rho_basis: assumed air condition, same as upstream VLM air20C default; not specimen measurement
parameters.EI_formula: EI_fin=abs(upstream rigid normalforce at20m/s)*span_length^2/compliance; engineering design definition, NOT fitted or measured material

gates.upstream_VLM_controls: all frozen engineering/cfd3d/gates_vlm.json controls must pass; no threshold edits
negative_controls: omit an actual load and detect conservation failure
deliberately excessive compliance20 retained as model-domain exit

glide.scope: Final static shape is rigidized and its CL atalpha4 held fixed during a separate flight proxy. Shape does NOT continuously relax as speed changes. No continuousFSI, no biological motor/energy calibration. Assumeddrag; no prescribed air thrust.
glide.mass_basis: assumed biological design mass, NOTresin model mass or measured specimen
glide.series_time_adapter: upstream series stores post-step state under k*dt; label retained active states at(k+1)*dt; initialstate explicitly recorded. Do not count interpolated water-event endpoints as integrated states. Ignore inactive/frozen series entries; terminalhold labeled.
glide.energy_scope: E=.5mV^2+mgh, expected drag power=-DV; lift orthogonalvelocity by existing equations; no energy renormalization

counts.shared_rigid_cases: same rigid input repeated only for paired comparison; not independent evidence

failures: All invalid, unconverged,nonfinite and missing arms preserved; no new cases or threshold changes to force a pass. Actualstatic iterations are NOT physicaltime; glide time distinct.
